resources.string: To play, use the files from your own PC copy of GTA Vice City. Copy the entire game directory to your device, then select it here. This APK contains the reVC engine and support files, not the copyrighted game data.
Select a Vice City folder with data, models and audio subfolders. data/gta_vc.dat and models/gta3.img were not found.
Game files found in %1$s. Ready to launch.
